name: Generation five - meta-labelled ITSM
hypothesis: The incumbent has edge and no discretion. Add a secondary model that declines the entries that resolve downward, and change nothing else - a filter is the only move that can improve the return and the toll at the same time.
mechanism: Meta-labelling (Lopez de Prado ch.3) over the 06:00 UTC 1.5% morning-move entry. Primary picks the side, secondary picks the size, and the sizes are one and zero.
